plan: [My value equals the current price, so winning now yields zero profit. Staying risks the price rising to $40.5 and a negative payoff if I win. There's no expected upside: I should drop to avoid potential loss.]

If I win now at $13 my profit is $0. Next increment is $13.5>13 so any later win yields negative profit. Staying risks paying more than my value. Dropping guarantees zero, which is weakly better than potential loss.

If I stay and win now at $17 my profit is zero. If the price advances to $17.5 and I win, profit is -$0.5. Because there's risk of a loss with no upside, I should avoid staying. Drop to avoid negative expected payoff.
